published_ranges._enclosure: no enclosure required (Black / Bright White PLA pages)
published_ranges._ams: 1 kg spools sold as AMS compatible (FAQ: all 1 kg rolls designed for AMS)
published_ranges._notes: Resin: virgin NatureWorks Ingeo PLA (some colours + Atomic additive / Pro additive package). Out of round 0.02 mm or less. Density 1.25 (relative density) and Tg 55-60C are from the generic 'Atomic Filament - PLA based 3D Filament' SDS (rev 08/03/2021), not a TDS. Bed 50-60C is printed only on the Black and Bright White PLA pages; most colour pages give no bed temperature. Atomic FAQ: all colours print nearly identically with the same temperature profiles, so marble, sparkle, pearl, translucent and shade-shifting colours are folded into this line. Also sold in 3.5 kg and 2.85 mm (Black, Bright White). No drying spec published for PLA.

conflicts: Black and Bright White PLA pages (https://atomicfilament.com/products/black-pla-filament, https://atomicfilament.com/products/bright-white-pla-filament) give nozzle 190-220C; ~150 other PLA colour/sample pages give 190-230C (used in fields).
